name: Umayyad Caliphate Falls
summary: The Abbasid armies defeat and execute the last Umayyad caliph Marwan II, who flees to Egypt where he is caught and killed. The Abbasids massacre the Umayyad family at a banquet. One prince, Abd al-Rahman, escapes through North Africa to Spain, founding the Emirate of Córdoba and maintaining Umayyad legitimacy there until 1031.

_quarry.structural_significance: Ends the Arab tribal aristocracy's dominance of Islam; the Abbasid revolution's ideological appeal to non-Arab Muslims shapes Islam's universal character; Abd al-Rahman's escape creates the permanent split caliphate.
